newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Jan core inflation rises 0.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Jan core inflation rises 0.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish core inflation rose 0.2 percent year-on-year in January after rising 0.4 percent in December, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Friday.
The mean of four economists forecasts for January core inflation was a 0.4 percent rise in a +0.2 to +0.5 range.

The Bank of Finland's target for the year-on-year change in the underlying rate of inflation - the central bank's chief gauge for monetary policy - is a rise of no more than around two percent. - Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245
